cscan_settings.m: function p = cscan_settings()
Keep the parameters together so they are easy to find.
把参数放在一起，方便查找和修改。
p.runHardware = false;
Default: calculate and plot the sequence without using either board.
默认只计算和画时序，不连接两块板卡。
p.showPlot = true;
Display the planned timing and, after a real run, the preview.
显示计划时序；真实运行后显示预览图。
p.device = "Dev1";
NI device name from the existing local program.
沿用现有本地程序中的 NI 设备名称。
p.sdkFolder = 'C:\AlazarTech\ATS-SDK\23.3.0\Samples_MATLAB\Include';
Windows folder containing AlazarDefs and the SDK MATLAB wrappers.
Windows 上包含 AlazarDefs 和 SDK MATLAB 函数的目录。
p.niRate = 200e3;
NI outputs 200,000 table rows per second; one row lasts 5 microseconds.
NI 每秒输出 200000 行时序，每行持续 5 微秒。
p.atsRate = 180e6;
ATS samples CH A at 180 million samples/s; checked against the hardware setup below.
ATS 对 CH A 每秒采样 1.8 亿点；后面会检查与板卡设置一致。
p.rangeV = 4;
CH A range is minus 4 to plus 4 volts, not a 4-volt total span.
CH A 量程为负 4 至正 4 伏，总跨度不是 4 伏。
p.stepUm = 0.5;
Historical X/Y calibration in micrometres per STEP; recheck if driver settings changed.
历史 X/Y 标定为每 STEP 0.5 微米；驱动设置改变后需复核。
p.speedMmS = 1;
Teaching choice: 1 mm/s for X, return, and Y; no acceleration ramp in this small example.
教学设置：X、回程和 Y 都用 1 毫米/秒；小范围示例不加加速段。
Number of X bins/records in each row, not the number of motor steps.
每行的 X 分箱或记录数，不是电机步数。
p.ny = 3;
Number of Y rows in the C-scan.
C-scan 的 Y 行数。
p.dxUm = 5;
Nominal distance between NPT triggers or width of one TS time bin.
NPT 触发间的名义距离，或 TS 一个时间分箱对应的名义宽度。
p.dyUm = 1;
Commanded Y spacing between adjacent scan rows.
相邻扫描行之间的 Y 命令间距。
p.startStep = 10;
Send the first acquisition trigger after this many X STEP cycles.
完成这么多个 X STEP 周期后发出第一个采集触发。
p.settleS = 0.02;
Hold position before and after each move; this is a chosen delay, not measured settling.
每段运动前后等待 0.02 秒；这是设置值，不是已测得的停稳时间。
p.recordSamples = 1024;
NPT samples per trigger: about 5.69 microseconds at 180 MS/s.
NPT 每个触发采 1024 点，在 180 MS/s 下约为 5.69 微秒。
p.streamBufferSamples = 524288;
TS transfers this many samples per DMA buffer; a buffer is not a laser pulse.
TS 每个 DMA 缓冲区传输这么多点；一个缓冲区不等于一个激光脉冲。
p.bufferCount = 4;
Reuse four DMA buffers instead of allocating one for every transfer.
循环复用四个 DMA 缓冲区，不为每次传输分配一个。
p.timeoutMs = 3000;
Fail a buffer wait after 3 seconds instead of waiting forever in MATLAB.
MATLAB 等待缓冲区超过 3 秒就报错，不一直等待。
p.triggerLevelCode = 150;
External trigger threshold code from the existing program; this is not 150 volts.
沿用现有程序的外触发阈值编码 150，它不是 150 伏。
p.outputRoot = fullfile(pwd, 'simple_cscan_data');
Put each real scan in its own subfolder here.
每次真实扫描的数据分别保存在这里的子目录中。
end
Return the settings structure p.
返回参数结构体 p。
make_scan_sequence.m: function s = make_scan_sequence(p, mode)
Build all motion and trigger arrays without touching hardware.
只生成运动和触发数组，不操作硬件。
assert(ismember(mode, ["NPT", "TS"]), 'Use NPT or TS.');
Accept only the two implemented modes.
只接受已经实现的两种模式。
validateattributes(p.nx, {'numeric'}, {'scalar','integer','positive','finite'});
Require a positive whole number of X positions.
要求 X 位置数是有限的正整数。
validateattributes(p.ny, {'numeric'}, {'scalar','integer','positive','finite'});
Require a positive whole number of Y rows.
要求 Y 行数是有限的正整数。
validateattributes(p.startStep, {'numeric'}, {'scalar','integer','nonnegative','finite'});
The chosen starting step cannot be negative or fractional.
指定起始步不能为负数或小数。
assert(all(isfinite([p.stepUm p.dxUm p.dyUm p.speedMmS p.niRate p.settleS])) & all([p.stepUm p.dxUm p.dyUm p.speedMmS p.niRate] > 0), 'Use positive finite motion settings.');
Reject zero, negative, or nonfinite motion parameters.
拒绝零值、负值或非有限的运动参数。
assert(p.speedMmS <= 4 & p.settleS >= 0.001, 'This no-ramp example requires speed <= 4 mm/s and settle >= 1 ms.');
Keep this simple no-ramp design within the historical low-speed range.
将这个无加速段示例限制在历史低速范围内，并保留方向建立时间。
s.stepTicks = p.niRate * p.stepUm / (1000 * p.speedMmS);
Number of NI time ticks in one motor STEP cycle.
一个电机 STEP 周期包含的 NI 时钟点数。
s.stepsPerPixel = p.dxUm / p.stepUm;
Convert X spacing from micrometres to motor steps.
把 X 间距从微米换算为电机步数。
ySteps = p.dyUm / p.stepUm;
Convert one Y row spacing to motor steps.
把一行 Y 间距换算为电机步数。
counts = [s.stepTicks s.stepsPerPixel ySteps];
Collect the values that must fit the discrete output grid.
收集必须落在离散输出网格上的数值。
assert(all(abs(counts-round(counts)) < 1e-9) & s.stepTicks >= 2, 'Choose integer ticks/step and integer steps/spacing.');
Do not silently round speed or spatial spacing.
不悄悄舍入速度或空间间距；不合适就报错。
s.stepTicks = round(s.stepTicks);
Remove harmless floating-point roundoff after checking.
检查后去掉浮点计算产生的微小误差。
s.stepsPerPixel = round(s.stepsPerPixel);
Store an exact integer step count.
保存精确的整数步数。
ySteps = round(ySteps);
Store the exact integer Y step count.
保存精确的 Y 整数步数。
s.pixelTicks = s.stepTicks * s.stepsPerPixel;
NI time ticks between successive planned X positions.
相邻计划 X 位置之间的 NI 时钟点数。
s.pixelSeconds = s.pixelTicks / p.niRate;
Time represented by one X bin.
每个 X 分箱代表的时间。
s.rowSeconds = p.nx * s.pixelSeconds;
Duration of the retained TS row, measured from its first trigger.
TS 保留的整行时间长度，从第一个触发开始计算。
s.xSteps = p.startStep + p.nx * s.stepsPerPixel;
Total X motion includes the lead-in steps before the acquisition region.
X 总运动包括采集区域之前的引入步数。
assert(s.xSteps*p.stepUm <= 5000 & (p.ny-1)*p.dyUm <= 5000, 'Keep this teaching scan within 5 mm per axis.');
Bound the relative command travel; this does not check the physical stage limits.
限制相对命令行程；这不能检查滑台当前是否接近物理限位。
s.forward = move_table(s.xSteps, 1, true, p, s.stepTicks);
Make X-forward motion with five output columns.
生成 X 正向运动，时序表有五列。
s.back = move_table(s.xSteps, 1, false, p, s.stepTicks);
Return X by exactly the commanded forward step count.
X 回程使用与去程相同的命令步数。
s.yNext = move_table(ySteps, 3, true, p, s.stepTicks);
Move Y forward by one row spacing.
将 Y 正向移动一个行间距。
s.yHome = move_table((p.ny-1)*ySteps, 3, false, p, s.stepTicks);
Reverse the accumulated Y commands after a successful full scan.
整幅扫描成功后，反向走完累计的 Y 命令步数。
s.firstTick = round(p.settleS*p.niRate) + p.startStep*s.stepTicks + 1;
MATLAB index of the first trigger; index 1 is time zero.
第一个触发的 MATLAB 索引；索引 1 对应零时刻。
s.triggerTicks = s.firstTick + (0:p.nx-1)*s.pixelTicks;
Planned NPT trigger indices across one row.
一行内各个计划 NPT 触发的索引。
if mode == "TS"
Triggered Streaming needs only the first trigger in the row.
Triggered Streaming 每行只需要第一个触发。
s.triggerTicks = s.firstTick;
Remove all later trigger commands.
删除后续所有触发命令。
end
Finish choosing the trigger pattern.
结束触发模式选择。
s.forward(s.triggerTicks, 5) = true;
Column 5 sends a one-NI-tick pulse at each chosen time.
第五列在指定时刻输出宽度为一个 NI 时钟点的脉冲。
s.xStartUm = p.startStep*p.stepUm + (0:p.nx-1)*p.dxUm;
Nominal commanded coordinates at the start of each bin.
每个分箱起始时刻对应的名义命令坐标。
s.yUm = (0:p.ny-1)*p.dyUm;
Relative commanded Y coordinates; the first row is zero.
相对 Y 命令坐标；第一行为零。
end
Finish building the scan sequence.
完成扫描时序生成。
function table = move_table(nSteps, stepColumn, direction, p, period)
Build a single X or Y movement with no acquisition triggers.
生成一段 X 或 Y 运动，不产生采集触发。
lead = round(p.settleS*p.niRate);
Convert the pre/post wait to NI table rows.
将运动前后等待时间换算为 NI 表格行数。
pattern = [true(floor(period/2),1); false(ceil(period/2),1)];
One high-then-low STEP cycle; this setup uses the falling edge.
一个先高后低的 STEP 周期；现有接法使用下降沿。
train = repmat(pattern, nSteps, 1);
Repeat that cycle once for every commanded step.
每个命令步重复一次这个周期。
table = false(2*lead + numel(train) + 1, 5);
Reserve five columns: X STEP, X DIR, Y STEP, Y DIR, acquisition trigger.
创建五列：X STEP、X DIR、Y STEP、Y DIR、采集触发。
table(:,2) = true;
Default X direction to the historical positive direction.
X 方向默认使用历史正向电平。
table(:,4) = true;
Default Y direction to the historical positive direction.
Y 方向默认使用历史正向电平。
table(:,stepColumn+1) = direction;
Set the direction for the axis that will move.
设置此次要运动的轴的方向。
table(lead+(1:numel(train)),stepColumn) = train;
Insert the STEP train between the two quiet intervals.
将 STEP 脉冲串放在前后两个静止等待段之间。
end
Finish the single-movement helper.
结束单段运动辅助函数。
cscan_preview.m: function values = cscan_preview(raw, p, mode)
Make a basic voltage-range preview; this is not depth reconstruction.

In NPT, every column is one triggered short record.

block = reshape(raw, p.recordSamples, p.nx);

else

span = double(max(block,[],1)) - double(min(block,[],1));
Find the largest minus smallest ADC code in each column.

values = span * (2*p.rangeV/65535);

yUm = s.yUm(row);
Record the commanded Y coordinate of this row.
记录这一行的 Y 命令坐标。
save(fullfile(result.folder,sprintf('row_%03d.mat',row)), 'raw','preview','yUm','row','-v7.3');
Save the raw row before moving to the next Y position.
在移动到下一个 Y 位置前保存本行原始数据。
result.previewV(row,:) = preview;
Put this row into the 2-D preview array.
把本行预览放入二维数组。
result.rowsDone = row;
Record how many rows were acquired and saved.
记录已经采集并保存的行数。
readwrite(dq, double(s.back), "OutputFormat", "Matrix");
Return X with triggers low; blocking is acceptable because ATS has stopped.
关闭触发并让 X 回程；ATS 已停止，所以这里可以阻塞等待。
if row < p.ny
Do not step Y after the final row.
最后一行后不再前进 Y。
readwrite(dq, double(s.yNext), "OutputFormat", "Matrix");
Move Y to the next row while acquisition is stopped.
在采集停止时把 Y 移动到下一行。
end
Finish the between-row Y move.
结束行间 Y 移动。
end
Finish acquiring every row.
完成所有行的采集。
readwrite(dq, double(s.yHome), "OutputFormat", "Matrix");
Reverse all commanded Y steps; this is not limit-switch homing.
反向走完全部 Y 命令步数；这不是通过限位开关归零。
result.complete = true;
Mark success only after acquisition and normal commanded returns finish.
只有采集及正常命令回程全部完成后才标记成功。
save(fullfile(result.folder,'summary.mat'), 'result');
Save the preview and completion status.
保存预览图数据和完成状态。
if p.showPlot
Show the measured preview if requested.
根据设置决定是否显示实测预览。
figure('Name','Amplitude preview / 幅度预览');
Open a separate figure for the preview.
为预览图打开单独窗口。
imagesc(s.xStartUm, s.yUm, result.previewV); axis xy; colorbar;
Display volts against nominal commanded coordinates.
按名义命令坐标显示以伏特为单位的结果。
xlabel('Nominal X bin start (um)'); ylabel('Commanded Y (um)');
Label the axes without claiming measured spatial accuracy.
标注坐标，但不把命令坐标说成已测得的精确位置。
title(mode+": voltage-range preview, not depth reconstruction");
State explicitly what the displayed quantity means.
明确说明显示的是电压范围预览，不是深度重建。
end
Finish preview display.
结束预览绘图。
end
Finish the shared C-scan procedure.
结束共用 C-scan 流程。
function raw = acquire_row(board, dq, p, s, mode)
Acquire exactly one row using mode-specific DMA settings.
按所选模式的 DMA 设置采集一行。
AlazarDefs;
Make SDK constants available inside this local function.
在此局部函数中载入 SDK 常量。
if mode == "NPT"
Choose the short-record acquisition layout.
选择短记录采集布局。
samples = p.recordSamples;
Number of samples in each NPT record.
每条 NPT 记录的采样点数。
records = gcd(p.nx,10);
Group up to ten records per buffer while dividing nx exactly.
每个缓冲区最多放十条记录，并保证正好整除 nx。
acquisitionRecords = p.nx;
Request exactly one triggered record per planned X position.
每个计划 X 位置请求一条触发记录。
wanted = samples*p.nx;
Total number of ADC samples to retain in this row.
本行需要保留的 ADC 总采样点数。
flags = bitor(ADMA_EXTERNAL_STARTCAPTURE, ADMA_NPT);
NPT waits for triggers after the explicit StartCapture call.
NPT 在显式调用 StartCapture 后等待触发。
AlazarSetRecordSize(board, 0, samples);
Use zero pre-trigger samples and the chosen post-trigger length.
使用零个预触发点和指定数量的触发后采样点。
else
Choose the per-row Triggered Streaming layout.
选择每行触发一次的连续采样布局。
samples = p.streamBufferSamples;
Transfer this many samples in each streaming buffer.
每个 streaming 缓冲区传输这么多采样点。
records = 1;
SDK streaming modes require one record per buffer.
SDK 的 streaming 模式要求每缓冲区记录数设为一。
acquisitionRecords = hex2dec('7FFFFFFF');
SDK streaming convention: keep going until AbortAsyncRead.
SDK 的 streaming 约定：持续采集，直到调用 AbortAsyncRead。
wanted = round(s.pixelSeconds*p.atsRate)*p.nx;
Retain the requested duration by counting samples, not by a software stopwatch.
按采样点数保留指定时间段，不依赖软件秒表决定数据长度。
flags = bitor(ADMA_EXTERNAL_STARTCAPTURE, ADMA_TRIGGERED_STREAMING);
Wait for the first hardware trigger, then sample without gaps.
等待第一个硬件触发，然后不间断采样。
end
Finish selecting NPT or TS parameters.
结束 NPT 或 TS 参数选择。
perBuffer = samples*records;
Total 16-bit samples transferred by one buffer.
一个缓冲区传输的 16 位采样点总数。
bytes = 2*perBuffer;
A 16-bit sample occupies two bytes.
一个 16 位采样点占两个字节。
nBuffers = ceil(wanted/perBuffer);
Read enough complete buffers to cover the desired row.
读取足够多的完整缓冲区，以覆盖需要的整行数据。
ringSize = min(p.bufferCount,nBuffers);
Allocate only as many ring buffers as this row can use.
只分配本行实际能用到的缓冲区数量。
buffers = cell(1,ringSize);
Keep the DMA memory pointers in a cell array.
用 cell 数组保存 DMA 内存指针。
raw = zeros(wanted,1,'uint16');
Allocate one row of raw unsigned ADC codes.
为一行无符号 ADC 原始编码分配内存。
try
Also clean up a partially allocated ring if memory allocation fails.
内存分配中途失败时，也要清理已经分配的部分。
for k = 1:ringSize
Allocate the small reusable ring.
分配小型可循环复用缓冲环。
buffers{k} = AlazarAllocBuffer(board, bytes);
Ask the SDK for DMA-compatible memory.
向 SDK 申请可用于 DMA 的内存。
end
Finish allocation before starting acquisition.
在开始采集前完成内存分配。
catch err
Handle a failure before the normal cleanup guard exists.
处理正常清理对象建立之前发生的分配失败。
release_buffers(board, buffers);
Free any DMA buffers already allocated.
释放此前已经分配的 DMA 缓冲区。
rethrow(err);
Preserve and report the original allocation error.
保留并报告原来的分配错误。
end
Finish the allocation error handler.
结束分配错误处理。
rowGuard = onCleanup(@() release_buffers(board, buffers));
Capture the completed pointer list for cleanup on return or error.
保存完整指针列表，正常返回或报错时都用它清理。
AlazarBeforeAsyncRead(board, CHANNEL_A, 0, samples, records, acquisitionRecords, flags);
Describe the acquisition and transfer layout to the board.
向板卡指定采集方式和数据传输布局。
for k = 1:ringSize
Give every initial buffer to the board.
将所有初始缓冲区交给板卡。
AlazarPostAsyncBuffer(board, buffers{k}, bytes);
Queue one empty buffer for incoming ADC data.
排队提交一个空缓冲区，等待 ADC 数据填入。
end
The board now has empty buffers available.
此时板卡已经有可用的空缓冲区。
preload(dq, double(s.forward));
Queue NI motion and trigger data without starting it.
预载 NI 运动和触发时序，但先不启动。
AlazarStartCapture(board);
Arm ATS first; it waits for the controlled external trigger.
先启动 ATS 等待；它会等待受控的外部触发。
start(dq);
Start the NI hardware-timed sequence after ATS is armed.
ATS 准备等待后，再启动 NI 硬件定时时序。
for b = 1:nBuffers
Copy completed buffers until the desired row is covered.
逐个复制完成的缓冲区，直到覆盖需要的整行数据。
k = mod(b-1,ringSize)+1;
Cycle through buffer indices 1, 2, ..., ringSize.
循环选择第 1、2、直到 ringSize 个缓冲区。
AlazarWaitAsyncBufferComplete(board, buffers{k}, p.timeoutMs);
Wait until this buffer is full; timeout/overflow raises an error.
等待此缓冲区填满；超时或溢出会报错。
setdatatype(buffers{k}, 'uint16Ptr', 1, perBuffer);
Interpret the DMA bytes as 16-bit unsigned samples.
将 DMA 字节解释为 16 位无符号采样点。
first = (b-1)*perBuffer+1;
Find where this buffer belongs in the row array.
计算此缓冲区在整行数组中的起始位置。
count = min(perBuffer,wanted-first+1);
Trim the final TS buffer to the requested valid sample count.
将最后一个 TS 缓冲区裁剪到所需的有效采样点数。
data = buffers{k}.Value;
Copy the completed DMA buffer into a MATLAB value.
将完成的 DMA 缓冲区复制为 MATLAB 数据。
raw(first:first+count-1) = data(1:count);
Append the valid part of this buffer in chronological order.
按时间顺序追加此缓冲区的有效部分。
if b+ringSize <= nBuffers
Reuse this buffer only when a later transfer will need it.
只有后续传输还需要它时才再次提交。
AlazarPostAsyncBuffer(board, buffers{k}, bytes);
Return the copied buffer to the DMA queue.
将已经复制完的缓冲区重新交回 DMA 队列。
end
Finish deciding whether to reuse this buffer.
结束是否复用缓冲区的判断。
end
All requested samples have now been copied.
所有需要的采样点已经复制完成。
AlazarAbortAsyncRead(board);
Stop ATS before processing data or starting the return motion.
在处理数据或开始回程前停止 ATS。
clear rowGuard
Abort again harmlessly, then release the allocated DMA memory now.
再次中止并立即释放已分配的 DMA 内存。
end
Finish this row acquisition function.
结束本行采集函数。
function release_buffers(board, buffers)
Clean up the explicit pointer list passed by the caller.
清理由调用者明确传入的缓冲区指针列表。
try
Abort must succeed before any DMA buffer is freed.
释放任何 DMA 缓冲区之前必须成功中止采集。
AlazarAbortAsyncRead(board);
Stop acquisition and release the board's claim on queued buffers.
停止采集，解除板卡对已提交缓冲区的使用。
catch err
Handle an abort failure without hiding the original error.
处理中止失败，同时避免掩盖原始错误。
warning('SimpleCscan:Abort','DMA abort failed; buffers retained: %s',err.message);
Keep memory allocated when the board might still be using it.
板卡可能仍在使用这些内存时，不释放它们。
return
Do not free possibly active DMA memory.
不释放可能仍在使用的 DMA 内存。
end
A successful abort makes freeing buffers appropriate.
成功中止后才能释放缓冲区。
for j = 1:numel(buffers)
Visit every pointer that may have been allocated.
检查每个可能已分配的指针。
if ~isempty(buffers{j})
Skip cells whose allocation never completed.
跳过尚未成功分配的空单元。
AlazarFreeBuffer(board, buffers{j});
Return this DMA allocation to the SDK.
通过 SDK 释放这一块 DMA 内存。
end
Finish checking this allocation.
结束此内存块的判断。
end
Finish freeing the buffer ring.
缓冲环释放完毕。
end
Finish the DMA cleanup function.
结束 DMA 清理函数。
function wait_for_ni(dq, durationS)
Wait for the remaining finite NI motion without changing the ATS sample count.
等待剩余的有限 NI 运动；不改变 ATS 保留的采样点数。
timer = tic;
Start a watchdog for a stuck NI operation, not an acquisition timing reference.
启动 NI 卡住时的监测秒表；它不是采集时间基准。
while dq.Running
Continue waiting while NI is still outputting the sequence.
NI 仍在输出时序时继续等待。
assert(toc(timer) < durationS+5, 'NI did not finish its finite sequence.');
Report a stuck run rather than wait forever.
如果有限时序一直未结束就报错，不无限等待。
Yield MATLAB briefly while the NI hardware keeps working.
MATLAB 短暂让出执行时间，NI 硬件仍继续工作。
end
NI has completed its finite output.
NI 已完成有限长度的输出。
read(dq, "all", "OutputFormat", "Matrix");
Drain the unused AI samples so they do not accumulate across rows.
读掉不用的 AI 样本，防止它们逐行积累。
end
Finish the NI waiting helper.
结束 NI 等待辅助函数。
